mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 59 degrees under clear skies at Verona Community Park with a full moon, and we are currently seeing an elevated air quality index of 52.

September is set to be a significant month with Mayor Diaz proclaiming it both Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month to address critical community needs, while residents should also plan for traffic delays on Highway M due to utility work starting next week.
There is plenty to do, with the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today, followed by the Verona Area Kids Triathlon and the Girls Try Hockey event happening tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Mint Explosion flavor of the day, as the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
